Aditya / Naomi —

TL;DR: We confirmed a small control-plane routing mismatch introduced by the 02:04 UTC agent config change. Impact is intermittent but reproducible in our staging mirrors. Root cause appears to be a timing regression in the management channel keepalive that increases control-channel backpressure under Umbracare's connection churn pattern.

What weve validated so far:
- Correlated 503 windows to increased retransmit and short-lived leader re-election within the tenants conductor mesh.
- Telemetry shows a ~3–12s spike on tail RPCs during those brief leader rotations.
- No data loss; KV caches appear consistent after rejoin.

Immediate mitigations (recommended):
1) Schedule rollback of the agent config to the previous build (v3.9.2) during a 60-minute low-traffic window. This is lowest-risk and reversible.
2) If customer declines rollback, we can: temporarily relax keepalive thresholds and add a short (30m) autoscale boost to the tenants pool.
3) Provide a diagnostic bundle (uploaded) and a short runbook for on-call to flush local router state on rejoin.

Attachments / evidence: uploaded diagnostic_bundle_20260906.zip to shared drive (link in the thread). Short-term rollback artifact validated in dev cluster.

Proposed rollback window: Mon 7 Sep 2026 02:00–03:00 UTC (customer local minimal traffic window per their logs). We need customer signoff and an ops standby (Marissa -> will lead).

Marissa Cole
Technical Escalations Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0166
